explication: Remotion is a React- and code-driven video creation platform. A creator or coding agent defines compositions and sequences, then uses Studio for interactive timeline editing or the CLI for programmatic rendering. Code is bundled, compositions are evaluated by the rendering engine, and video output is produced locally or through cloud infrastructure. The repository also contains reusable animation, caption, audio, effects, design-system, browser-studio, recording, and storage capabilities. Sampled files show timeline control, sequence registration, browser-project persistence, audio scheduling, cloud progress reads, and local device preferences.
